consequence.statement: PushSecret v1alpha1 resources setting spec.template.engineVersion to "v1" are rejected by the API server because that enum value was removed.
consequence.remediation: Change spec.template.engineVersion to a still-allowed value before upgrading.

original.statement: The enum value "v1" was removed from spec.template.engineVersion in the PushSecret external-secrets.io/v1alpha1 schema, so PushSecrets using it are rejected by the API server.

decision.reason: The CRD bundles for v0.15.0 [ev-9889c9b8706d] and v0.16.0 [ev-e08924afdc47] show that "v1" was removed from the enum for spec.template.engineVersion in the v1alpha1 PushSecret schema. The deterministic crd-schema:tightened check confirmed this from those artifacts. Once an enum value is removed, the API server rejects any PushSecret that is created or updated with that value, so resource-rejected (mandatory work) is the right kind. The remediation, switching to a still-allowed value, matches. The evidence doesn't set a severity, and the proposals split between medium and high, so "high" is a judgment call rather than something the evidence proves.
